messages:
maria: Hey @lee @sam — pinging for runtime + platform + infra + security approvals on this PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/2187. Changes are eviction fallback tweak, dyn-batch kernel selector, and a canary config. Need to merge by EOW if possible. CI is green except one flaky e2e on macos runner.

lee: Looking now. tagging @alex (infra) and @security-bot for KMS/IAM checks. Can you confirm the autoscaler bits?

alex: I skimmed the autoscaler diff. Overall fine but we need a short migration doc and a rollback script before canary. Also prefer disabling burst-scaling for the first canary run.

sam: runtime: LGTM except one nit on kv cache TTL and one inline suggestion about the kernel selection heuristics. I'll add the comment. Also +1 on pinning model-version when we fallback.

maria: cool, i'll make those changes. question for @security-bot — we added a new KMS key usage in private deploy flow, any immediate blockers?

security-bot: quick sec check: no major blockers. small IAM tweak required (service account needs kms.decrypt). I'll drop an exact policy snippet in the PR comments. Marking as 'sec-reviewed' once applied.

nicky: If infra + runtime are happy, monday morning canary window (Mon 09:00-11:00 PT) works. Who's owning rollback ops during the window?

lee: I can take rollback owner if infra provides the playbook/scripts and runtime confirms the rollback flags.

alex: Confirmed. I'll add a rollback playbook gist in the PR after maria updates — includes `kubectl rollout undo`, cache-clear steps, and a short smoke test.

maria: Updated the PR: added migration_steps.md, pinned model version to v1.9.2 for fallback, removed burst-scaling flag for canary, and included rollback snippet:

```bash
# rollback example
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/inference-runtime
# clear prefix cache from redis
redis-cli -h redis.internal del "kvcache:*"
```

PTAL @sam @alex @lee @security-bot. Aiming to merge Mon 08:30 PT if CI passes and we have infra/runtime/sec approval. Thanks! :rocket:
